description: PostgreSQL 18 quantified array comparisons, UNNEST ordinality, variadic expansion, FOREACH, aggregates, and indexed array predicates
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_array_integration (id INT4 PRIMARY KEY, values_int INT4[], labels TEXT[]);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_array_integration VALUES (1, ARRAY[1,2], ARRAY['alpha','beta']), (2, ARRAY[2,3], ARRAY['beta']), (3, '[0:1]={4,5}'::INT4[], ARRAY[]::TEXT[]);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_array_integration_labels_gin ON type_matrix_array_integration USING GIN (labels);

SELECT 3 = ANY('{{1,2},{3,4}}'::INT4[]) AS multidimensional_any, 5 <> ALL('{{1,2},{3,4}}'::INT4[]) AS multidimensional_all, 2 < ANY(ARRAY[1,NULL,3]) AS any_with_null, 4 < ALL(ARRAY[5,NULL,6]) AS all_with_null, 1 = ANY(NULL::INT4[]) AS null_array, 1 = ANY(ARRAY[]::INT4[]) AS empty_array;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_array_integration WHERE labels @> ARRAY['beta'] ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_array_integration WHERE values_int >= ARRAY[2,3] ORDER BY values_int, id;
SELECT * FROM UNNEST('[0:1][5:6]={{1,2},{3,4}}'::INT4[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(value, ordinality);
SELECT * FROM UNNEST(ARRAY[10,20], ARRAY['a']) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(number_value, label, ordinality);
SELECT concat_ws('-', VARIADIC ARRAY['a','b','c']) AS joined, concat(VARIADIC ARRAY['x',NULL,'z']) AS concatenated;
SELECT array_agg(value ORDER BY value DESC), array_agg(value ORDER BY value) FILTER (WHERE value > 1) FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) AS input(value);
SELECT array_agg(values_int ORDER BY id) FROM type_matrix_array_integration WHERE id < 3;

CREATE FUNCTION type_matrix_foreach_sum(input INT4[]) RETURNS INT4 LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE item INT4; total INT4 := 0; BEGIN FOREACH item IN ARRAY input LOOP total := total + item; END LOOP; RETURN total; END $$;

CREATE FUNCTION type_matrix_foreach_slice(input INT4[]) RETURNS INT4[] LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE item INT4[]; totals INT4[] := '{}'; BEGIN FOREACH item SLICE 1 IN ARRAY input LOOP totals := array_append(totals, item[1] + item[2]); END LOOP; RETURN totals; END $$;
